nodes.label: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Parameter Set
nodes.description: Fast variant parameter set for SHA2-128 instantiated Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signatures specified in NIST FIPS 205, targeting NIST Security Category 1.

nodes.label: RoCEv2 Data Center Quantized Congestion Notification (DCQCN)
nodes.description: Hardware-rate congestion control mechanism combining Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) and PFC to prevent head-of-line blocking across NVMe-oF memory fabrics.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Orthographic Text Normalizer
nodes.description: Arabic text normalization pipeline in CAMeL Tools standardizing Alef variants, Ta Marbuta, Ha, and removing non-linguistic diacritics and orthographic noise.

nodes.label: W3C SPARQL 1.1 Query Algebra Execution Engine Specification
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation defining relational query execution algebra over RDF graphs, including Join, Union, Filter, LeftJoin, and Graph pattern evaluation.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Single-Source Shortest Path (SSSP) Algebraic Kernel
nodes.description: Parallel shortest-path graph algorithm utilizing vector-matrix multiplication over the Min-Plus (Tropical) semiring in GraphBLAS.
